## Backup to GitHub
Backs up Sorted_Signals-tagged workflows to GitHub on a schedule.

Files land under `YYYY/MM/{workflowId}.json` inside `gh_repo_path`.

Repo owner/name/path and Telegram chat ID come from the **global_variables** data table (not n8n Variables).

**`gh_repo_path` note:** Config normalizes the path for GitHub (no leading slash; trailing `/` if non-empty).
- `workflows/` → `workflows/`
- `/workflows/` → `workflows/`
- `workflows` → `workflows/`

The workflow calls itself per item to limit memory. Start/complete/fail notifies go to Telegram.

### Time to Run
Template note: ~30 min first run / ~12 min later for ~1400 workflows on n8n 1.44.1. This instance is much smaller.

assignments.name: repo_path
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const p = String($json.gh_repo_path ?? '').replace(/^\/+/, ''); return !p || p.endsWith('/') ? p : `${p}/`; })() }}
